# eclipse-refactor

[All servers](../mcp-tools.md)

Version: 1.0.0. Tools: 16.

## moveResource

Moves a file or folder to a different location within the project. For Java files, prefer using refactorMoveJavaType instead to ensure all references are updated.

Input schema type: object.

| Parameter | Schema type | Java type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| projectName | string | String | No | The name of the project containing the resource. Optional if source path is unique across projects or starts with /projectName/ |
| sourcePath | string | String | Yes | The path to the file or folder relative to the project root, or absolute path starting with /projectName/ |
| targetPath | string | String | Yes | The target directory path relative to the project root where the resource should be moved to |

## refactorApplyPreview

Apply exactly the frozen position-based Java refactoring identified by a previewId. Refuses changed or unsaved affected sources before writing any files. Tokens expire after 15 minutes and are consumed on an apply attempt; read all report pages first. Preserves Eclipse refactoring undo.

Input schema type: object.

| Parameter | Schema type | Java type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| previewId | string | String | Yes | One-use ID returned by a position-based refactoring with preview=true |

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| filePath | string | String | Yes | Java file relative to project, /project/path, or native absolute path |

| newName | string | String | No | newName |
| returnType | string | String | No | returnType |

| preview | boolean | Boolean | No | Create a frozen preview and one-use previewId for refactorApplyPreview (default: false). False applies directly against current source without preview protection. |

## refactorExtractMethod

Extract selected code lines into a new method. This is the most commonly used refactoring operation. The refactoring will analyze the code block, determine parameters and return values automatically, create a new method, and replace the original code with a method call.

Input schema type: object.

| Parameter | Schema type | Java type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| projectName | string | String | No | The name of the project containing the Java file. Optional if file path is unique across projects or starts with /projectName/ |
| filePath | string | String | Yes | The path to the Java file relative to the project root (e.g., 'src/com/example/Calculator.java') or absolute path starting with /projectName/ |
| startLine | string | int | Yes | The starting line number of the code block to extract (1-based index, inclusive) |
| endLine | string | int | Yes | The ending line number of the code block to extract (1-based index, inclusive) |
| methodName | string | String | Yes | The name for the new extracted method |
| visibility | string | String | No | The visibility modifier for the new method: 'public', 'private', 'protected', or 'package'. Defaults to 'private' |

## refactorGetPreview

Read the saved full refactoring report in pages of at most 100000 characters. Follow the returned offsets in order to read the entire diff before refactorApplyPreview. Does not recalculate or change files.

Input schema type: object.

| Parameter | Schema type | Java type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| previewId | string | String | Yes | ID returned by a position-based refactoring with preview=true |
| offset | string | Integer | No | Zero-based report character offset (default: 0); use the next offset returned by the preceding page |

## refactorMoveJavaType

Moves a Java class/interface/enum to a different package using Eclipse's refactoring mechanism. This updates the package declaration and ALL references throughout the workspace. The target package will be created if it doesn't exist.

Input schema type: object.

| Parameter | Schema type | Java type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| projectName | string | String | No | The name of the project containing the Java file. Optional if file path is unique across projects or starts with /projectName/ |
| filePath | string | String | Yes | The path to the Java file relative to the project root (e.g., 'src/com/example/MyClass.java') or absolute path starting with /projectName/ |
| targetPackage | string | String | Yes | The fully qualified target package name (e.g., 'com.example.newpackage') |

## refactorRenameJavaType

Renames a Java class/interface/enum using Eclipse's refactoring mechanism. This updates the type name, file name, and ALL references throughout the workspace. Use this instead of renameFile for Java files to ensure all references are updated correctly.

Input schema type: object.

| Parameter | Schema type | Java type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| projectName | string | String | No | The name of the project containing the Java file. Optional if file path is unique across projects or starts with /projectName/ |
| filePath | string | String | Yes | The path to the Java file relative to the project root (e.g., 'src/com/example/MyClass.java') or absolute path starting with /projectName/ |
| newTypeName | string | String | Yes | The new name for the Java type (without .java extension, e.g., 'NewClassName') |

## refactorRenamePackage

Renames a Java package using Eclipse's refactoring mechanism. This renames the package directory, updates all package declarations in contained files, and updates ALL references throughout the workspace.

Input schema type: object.

| Parameter | Schema type | Java type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| projectName | string | String | No | The name of the project containing the package. Optional if package is unique across projects. |
| packageName | string | String | Yes | The current fully qualified package name (e.g., 'com.example.oldpackage') |
| newPackageName | string | String | Yes | The new package name - can be fully qualified (e.g., 'com.example.newpackage') or just the last segment to rename |

| Parameter | Schema type | Java type | Required | Description |
